exact_statement: performance improves as m increases, but saturates after a critical negative data size; the empirical critical trend lies between sqrt(n) and n and is closer to n

domain.data: DFN subsets described as 6M, 10M, and 14M anchors
domain.negative_positive_independence: not auditable from released subset identities

falsification_predicate.precritical: a released curve fails to improve from 1% to 10% or from 10% to 40%
falsification_predicate.saturation: a released curve has range greater than 1.5 percentage points from 40% through 100%
falsification_predicate.scaling: the free-coefficient empirical exponent is outside [0.5, 1.0]
falsification_predicate.assumptions: a contradiction counts only if shared-negative and independence assumptions are established
